Exam Date & Time: 12-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  DISTRIBUTED CLOUD SECURITY [IT-4002]  
Marks: 50                                                                              Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           You are part of a cybersecurity team tasked with improving user authentication  
  mechanisms for a cloud-based enterprise application that handles sensitive customer  
  data. Based on your understanding of modern authentication techniques, apply                (5)  
  A)        appropriate strategies to enhance user authentication and ensure a high level of data  
  security.  
  
  B)       Apply the steps of the Needham-Schroeder (NS) protocol to demonstrate how secure  
  communication is established between two parties and represent the process with a clear (5)  
  and accurate diagram.  
  
2)            Apply appropriate access control mechanisms to regulate and restrict access to sensitive  
  data and resources in specific security scenarios and justify your choices.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Solve common cybersecurity issues in modern enterprises by applying Identity and  
  Access Management (IAM) frameworks that ensure secure and appropriate resource             (5)  
  access.  
  
3)            Apply your understanding of network security to explain how the Ping of Death attack  
  can affect system stability. Demonstrate how to recognize its symptoms in a network  
  environment and implement appropriate security measures to prevent and mitigate its        (5)  
  A)       impact.  
  
  B)       Apply Shared Responsibility Model in cloud computing define the security roles and  
  responsibilities of cloud service providers (CSPs) and customers?                          (5)  
  
4)            Apply your understanding of common cloud security risks by identifying the top seven  
  threats in a cloud environment, and demonstrate how appropriate mitigation strategies  
  (5)  
  can be used to address each risk effectively  
  A)  
  B)       An IT team identifies gaps in data access control and audit logging.  
  Use the CIA triad to evaluate the risks associated with these gaps and propose solutions (5)  
  that also align with regulatory compliance.  
  
5)            A company is planning to implement server virtualization to improve resource  
  utilization and system isolation. As a virtualization consultant, you are tasked with  
  recommending the appropriate hypervisor type. Analyse the key differences between          (5)  
  A)       Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors in terms of architecture, performance, and security, and  
  discuss the advantages of each.

B)          Your organization is considering deploying VMware ESXi to virtualize its server  
  infrastructure for better efficiency and security. As a virtualization specialist, you are  
  asked to analyse its suitability. Analyse the key features, architecture, and security       (5)  
  enhancements of VMware ESXi, and describe how these aspects support robust,  
  scalable, and secure virtualization in an enterprise environment.  
  
  
-----End-----
